verses.1: And one of the seven messengers who carried the seven messages came and spoke to me. He said, “Lord, I will show you the punishment of that great prostitute who sat down over many waters.”
verses.2: The kings of the land were corrupted by them, and those who lived on this land were also corrupted by their wine of corruption.
verses.3: And I was thrown into the wilderness by a wind. There I saw a woman sitting on a red beast, filled with insults and curses. She had seven heads and ten horns.
verses.4: And the woman was adorned with purple and red colors; she was also covered with gold and precious stones. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with the filth and impurities associated with her prostitution.
verses.5: And on its lid was written a secret name: Babylon the Great, the mother of all prostitutes and the source of all evils in the world.
verses.6: And I saw that the woman was covered with the blood of the saints and also with the blood of the martyrs. I was astonished to see her in such a state.
verses.7: And the angel said to me, “Why are you amazed? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that devours her. This beast has seven heads and ten horns.”
verses.8: The monster you saw was both real and not real at the same time. It will surely return from the abyss, and it will bring destruction with it. The inhabitants of the earth will be amazed when they see this monster—because it was both real and not real at the same time.
verses.9: And that mind which possesses wisdom. There are seven heads, and seven mountains where the woman sits upon them. And there are also seven kings.
verses.10: The five fell; one remains alive. The other still hasn’t arrived yet. And when he does arrive, he’ll need to be taken care of for a while.
verses.11: And that beast, whether it exists or not, is also considered to be one of the seven. It’s one of the seven things that can lead to destruction.
verses.12: And those ten horns that you saw, they represent ten kings. They did not receive their kingdoms as real rulers. Instead, they received power to rule for a time, just like other kings do.
verses.13: They have one opinion, and they give that opinion to the beast as their power and authority.
verses.14: They will fight against me after the ram has been sacrificed. But the ram will defeat them, because it is the king of kings and the ruler of rulers. And those who follow it are chosen and faithful people.
verses.15: And he said to me: “The waters you saw there… among those waters, there are people and crowds, as well as different nations and languages.”
verses.16: And those ten horns that you saw, along with that monster, will hate the prostitute. They will desecrate her and make her naked. They will also eat her flesh. They will burn her alive in fire.
verses.17: For the God has given them the desire to carry out His will. They must establish one single will and give their kingdom to that beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
verses.18: And the woman you saw is the great city that holds power over all the kings of this land.
